Possible C-attack/O-attack products and anti/syn pi-allylic palladium intermediates were classified as a mechanism/product map, not an independent experiment.
Table 1 entry 1 conditions and negative side-product observations were linked to the corresponding page-3 optimization row instead of duplicated.

Scheme 2 structures are mechanistic candidates and remain unverified.

Eleven solvent/base rows were represented; Table 2 entry 1 was merged with identical Table 1 entry 2. Trace yield in entry 11 was preserved qualitatively.
Scope commentary and the standard-condition statement were used only to interpret Tables 3 and 4 on page 4; broad claims were not duplicated as experiments.
